title: MUSCLE MANGA - Ohma "The Ashura" Tokita's Physique in Kengan Ashura (part. 1)
summary: A scripted character analysis of Ohma Tokita from Kengan Ashura covering his deceptively modest look, martial-arts physique, technique-based fighting with kinetic vision, the costly Advance power-up, and the Ashura temperament behind it. Part 1 of a series that will cover his later physique upgrade.
claims: Ohma Tokita is 6 ft and 185 lb, very lean and jacked especially in the upper body, a classic case of looking small in clothes
His physique was built by and for martial arts with minimal body fat, which makes him look small next to other fighters and casts him as an underdog, like 5'6 Baki
Ohma relies on technique over brute force, using kinetic vision (seeing the flow of power) to anticipate and redirect opponents, a trait shared with Grappler Baki
The Advance borrows vital energy for speed and striking torque but damages his cardiovascular health and puts him in a trance where he takes blows he should dodge
Every man has dreamed of becoming the strongest man on earth; Ohma's goal is unoriginal but pure
Ohma embodies the Ashura of Japanese folklore: warriors who live for battle, with huge egos, jealousy and constant inner conflict
His muscles double in size within 48 hours before the tournament, a shonen protagonist perk
